scope:
Conditional 60%/50 K ion commissioning ledger, including an 80 AU sky.

Uses the saved source family; no new plasma, material or nuclear-data fit.
The mass/power reserve and particle-processing costs are selected requirements.
Run with docs/protium-fusion and /tmp/protium-python on PYTHONPATH.

capture_bank.scope:
Homogeneous 2200 m/s equivalent thermal-flux catalyst inventory screen; not neutron transport.

Most tabulated cross sections are NIST total absorption values, so assigning
all absorption to the desired capture gives a lower bound on required stock.
V50 uses the 1991 measured radiative-capture value, 21(+4,-2) barn.

startup.neutral_store_note: Neutral/cold means outside the MeV ion plasma. Store heat at the warm process temperature, not on the 4.2 K coil circuit.
startup.startup_scope: Independent inventory fill law under fixed source flows; not a coupled transient isotope-network solution. Stable bridge replaces the future decay inventory, so its mass is not added twice.
startup.weak_energy_note: The underlying ledger assigns all weak ground-state Q and a known-isomer margin to escaping neutrinos, so no delayed weak-decay heat is credited. Actual electromagnetic decay energy requires warm-store heat handling and a later partition refinement.
